name: FACT-Ray
status: The tables of the brief of 10 November 2026 (briefs/fact-ray-brief.md), implemented exactly as written and marked provisional. FACT-Ray is built inside gamma-ray.sgit.ai first and will move to its own site.
scores: How far one fact can be trusted: who says it, how firmly it is recorded and proved, and who stands behind it. It does not score whether the fact is true.

axes.name: Source
axes.question: Who is saying it?
axes.defined_by: the source's relationship to the subject of the fact

levels.name: No data
levels.meaning: Nothing found. Never read as no.
levels.spectrum: No public page on audit logs

levels.name: Discovered
levels.meaning: We (an agent or a journalist) found it in public material and interpreted it
levels.spectrum: Our agent read the vendor's documents
levels.news: A reporter inferred it from a filing

levels.name: Subject
levels.meaning: The party the fact is about says it

levels.name: Counterparty
levels.meaning: Someone on the other side of a relationship with the subject
levels.news: A client, an employee, an affected party

levels.name: Authority
levels.news: A regulator, a court, a statistics office

axes.name: Record
axes.question: How firmly is it recorded and proved?
axes.defined_by: record, attribution and proof, not the medium

levels.name: Written
levels.meaning: Recorded, but informal or unattributed: a chat, a forum post, an employee's personal blog

levels.name: On record
levels.meaning: Attributable through an accountable channel: a named role, the official domain, a signature

levels.name: Linked
levels.meaning: On record and pointing to an artefact anyone can open: a document page, an endpoint that resolves, data, a certificate

levels.name: Reviewed
levels.meaning: The artefact is captured and hashed (SHA-256, with the read date), and someone other than the claimant has checked that the claim matches it

axes.name: Accountability
axes.question: Who stands behind it?
axes.defined_by: every actor in the chain, with kind, identity, capacity and independence

levels.name: Agent-checked
levels.meaning: One or more identified agents reviewed it

levels.name: Human-checked
levels.meaning: A named human reviewed it; capacity unstated or junior

levels.name: Practitioner-validated
levels.meaning: A human in a relevant role, or with a relevant qualification, signed it

levels.name: Accountable-signed
levels.meaning: The person who answers for it signed on record: owner, officer, licensed professional, the publishing operator

levels.name: Panel
levels.meaning: Two or more independent signers, each at A3 or above

rules: Never show a band without its S·R·A coordinates.
The band matrix and the cap table are published as data; changes are versioned and dated.
Contested claims are shown side by side, never resolved quietly.
A parent never averages its children.
Quoted spans are exact and under fifteen words.
Corrections propagate to every page and every parent node, with a dated changelog entry.
FACT-Ray scores trust, not truth. A band is never called true or verified.
The same rules for us: our own publications are scored first.
